summary: Iteration 5 E2E testing of prompt-maestro v1 (promo codes, likes, latino_owned filter, 4 tiers) + frontend smoke + regression. Backend: 31/31 iteration5 tests PASS (100%). Full suite: 108/112 pass (96%). All NEW endpoints fully working: POST /api/promo-codes/apply (GETMANO50 assigns pro plan, founding_member=True, blocks duplicate use with 400, invalid code 404), POST /api/providers/{id}/like toggles likes_count up/down with auth required, GET /api/providers?latino_owned=true correctly filters to yes-only providers, POST /api/providers/me/plan accepts all 4 tiers (free/basic/pro/premium) and rejects invalid via Literal validation. Regression OK: auth, search, featured, by-slug (gallery=3 items after backend restart heal), reviews, service-requests, messages (uses body field), upload, admin endpoints, favorites all green. Search /buscar loads. eCard public renders 'Latino-owned' badge, WhatsApp button, gallery (3 items), reviews, 'Recomendar 3' (LikeButton). /provider/onboarding correctly redirects anonymous to /login. Admin & Provider login both navigate to dashboards without white-screen.

minor.issue: Wipes provider gallery (and any field not sent) because handler does payload.model_dump() + $set, and ProviderProfileIn.gallery defaults to []. Any partial UI update that omits gallery clears all images. backend_test::test_update_my_provider_profile reproduces this and the demo provider gallery silently goes to 0. Backend restart heals via seed $set but UI-driven updates leak it again. Fix: switch to model_dump(exclude_unset=True) so omitted fields aren't $set.
test_create_review_and_duplicate_rejected — duplicate-per-user check still missing (carryover from iter-4). 2nd review from same client_user still inserted.

ui_bugs.issue: Component renders as 'Recomendar 3' button but lacks data-testid='like-button' attribute, making automated testing harder. Functional in browser (no clicks tested as anonymous user, but element present).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1388 lines — should be split (auth, providers, messaging, admin, promo, ads).
PUT /providers/me has the silent-wipe bug noted above; ProviderProfileIn.gallery defaults to [] so any consumer that does not explicitly set it loses data.
promo_codes.update_one is racey for high concurrency — currently mitigated by the `current_uses: {$lt: max_uses}` filter which is correct; nice.
apply_promo_code marks user.founding_member but does NOT check if user already has a non-free plan — could downgrade a paying user to GETMANO50's pro tier (unlikely flow but worth a guard).
ProviderProfileIn.latino_owned not in payload model — only set via separate PUT /providers/me/latino-owned endpoint; ensure onboarding UI calls that endpoint after profile create.
No rate limiting on POST /api/providers/{id}/like — a single user is dedup'd by likes collection unique-ish lookup, but multiple users via registration can artificially inflate counts.

rca_of_the_issue: PUT /providers/me silent gallery wipe: ProviderProfileIn.gallery has default `[]` in pydantic. When frontend submits a partial profile update without the `gallery` key, pydantic populates it with `[]`, and the handler does `payload.model_dump()` (which includes ALL fields with defaults) followed by `$set`. This unsets gallery on every profile edit. Reproduced by backend_test.py::test_update_my_provider_profile which omits gallery and silently wipes the demo provider's 3 gallery items. Mitigation: replace `update = payload.model_dump()` with `update = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` at server.py:703, OR add explicit exclusions for collections. This also affects photos, languages, services, additional_categories, hours, social — any list/dict field with a default.
